item.title: Version 0.16.0
item.description:
Six things, mostly about the window.
The model picker and the Break Down button had been pushed off the toolbar into an overflow chevron. They now have the trailing edge to themselves, everything else moved to the leading side, and the windows that were unlabelled icons are in a new Script menu with a shortcut each. The default window is wide enough to show all of it.
The script pane shows the whole script in one scroll, with a marked line at each scene carrying its number, its eighths and the colour of paper it was printed on. Scroll past a marker and the breakdown follows you; pick a scene and the script scrolls to it.
There is a switch for each department above the breakdown, so you can walk a whole episode looking at nothing but the props.
A run now says what it found when it finishes — the counts, the departments, how long it took, and the parts worth a second look: scenes it found nothing in and quotes it could not trace back to the page.
Reports and prints carry a watermark, on by default. The name is read off the script you imported: distribution services stamp the recipient into the copy, and paperwork printed from that copy should say which copy it came from. You can change it or switch it off.

item.title: Version 0.15.1
item.description: The walkthrough's last page shows a code to point a phone at rather than a link.

item.title: Version 0.15.0
item.description: A board for everything pinned in a script, and pictures of one particular thing rather than a whole scene. Crash reports are written locally when something goes wrong — never sent anywhere, and they hold no part of any script.

item.title: Version 0.14.0
item.description: Finish a breakdown by hand: add what the model missed, correct what it found, write notes on scenes. Everything you change is recorded and survives a re-run. Pin reference pictures to a scene and print them as a look book — location and camera details are taken out of every image on the way in.

item.title: Version 0.13.0
item.description: Edit a breakdown by hand: add what the model missed, correct what it found, write notes on scenes. Everything you change is recorded and survives a re-run. Importing a revision now asks what should happen to notes on the scenes it changes.

item.title: Version 0.12.0
item.description: A walkthrough on first run and from the Help menu. Updates now say that the app has to restart to finish installing, and let you choose when.

item.title: Version 0.11.1
item.description: Fixes the launch check, which found updates and then reported none.
